description.en:
Starts fading a screen out to white over a number of frames (a white flash when the length is 0). The call returns straight away; wait with CMND_IS_WHITE_FADE. Undo it with CMND_WHITE_FADE_IN.
Screens use SCREEN_A (0, top), SCREEN_B (1, bottom) and SCREEN_AB (2, both).
While an event has its bottom-screen background loaded (the EvSubBg image), a fade asked for SCREEN_A is applied to both screens instead.
The ev_main helper StartWhiteFadeOut wraps this call with the waiting loop.
Length of the fade in frames.
Always null (also when the script system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments are given, in which case nothing starts).

examples.case: A white flash at the end of EncountEffect (real code, from ie4_ev_main.nut)
